plan: With a private value of $28, I want to maximize potential profit. Since the prize is randomly valued between $0-$49, rational bidders will likely bid strategically near their true value. This allows me to win if others bid lower, while protecting against overpaying. The second-price auction mechanism incentivizes honest, near-true-value bidding.
